reserves.name: Piku reserve-strategy envelope
reserves.issuerOrObligor: PikuDAO, Balsa Technologies, and third-party DeFi strategy counterparties

sources.label: Stablewatch Piku USP analysis (secondary current-deployment table, not issuer attestation)

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-08-08: Piku docs still describe USP backing as BMMF Turkey FX arbitrage, carry trades, on-chain yield and RWAs, but publish no dated primary-source allocation table or holdings snapshot. Stablewatch's secondary research (published 2025-10-15, modified 2026-03-11) includes a current-deployment table stating BMMF Turkey FX Arbitrage 50%, Giza Arma Agent 10%, Almanak Autonomous Liquidity USD 10%, USD.AI sUSDai 10%, Ethena USDe & sUSDe 10%, Aave aUSDT 5%, and cash stablecoins 0%; the article also says 40% is spread over six DeFi protocols. Because this is a third-party analysis, not an issuer attestation, and is at least 150 days old as of this review, the envelope is kept as 100% strategy other with knownUnknownExposurePct=100 rather than adopting the secondary split as reviewed fact.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Issuer strategy-category documentation plus Stablewatch secondary current-deployment table; no issuer-published dated weights or holdings snapshot
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current strategy weights, off-chain positions and venues, DeFi protocol weights, RWA holdings, stablecoin-buffer weights, and custody balances are not published in a dated primary-source snapshot.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Issuer materials describe the strategy categories but publish no current component weights, so the aggregate cannot be split or dependency-linked without fabrication.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-1 (lead usde-ethena)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: Piku publishes no custodian identities, account structures, or insolvency terms for either the off-chain BMMF leg or the on-chain DeFi allocations. Reserve deployment into third-party strategies is the disclosed design; whether any independent custodian holds assets is not documented.
